findings.quote: Recreational use of high-dose DXM is known as robotripping (from Robo—DXM street name and Robitussin—a cough syrup brand name). Indeed, some of the effects observed by subjects who abused DXM are described as follows: “I walk like … a robot. Identically. I feel relaxed, but I walk like some handicapped cyborg.

findings.quote: Noteworthy, DXM is safe only when it is used properly, according to the officially approved summary of the medicinal product (SmPC).
